notes: SPLIT SHEET, two frames separated by a diagonal break line. The LOWER frame (Mill Creek mouth) is the WEST part; its east edge (x~3950, W 6th numbers 1287-1297, Front) continues at the west edge of the UPPER frame (x~200, W 6th numbers 1285 down to 1201 at Harriet, W Front). W 6th appears in both frames (upper y~380, lower y~3270), so georeference the frames separately (part field). Lower frame: the street off the Mill Creek iron bridge runs ESE as one straight line (north face slope 0.444-0.448) labelled W. 6TH (60') and then FRONT beyond the junction; W 6th proper branches due east at the Y junction (2092,3270) where the diagonal centreline meets the E-W W 6th centreline. Horne (50') enters from the north and ends at W 6th. Front's south side is open railroad land, so its centreline is taken as north face + half of 60'. Upper frame: W Front (66', B&O S.W. R.R. tracks in the street) runs between the blocks; south face is railroad land except at Harriet. At Harriet, Sloo Alley (20', west side) and Sloo Street (40', east side, name on sheet 18) share the north building line, so their centrelines are ~37 px apart: recorded as two T's. Railroad bridges ignored.
